title: GOOLOO GT4000 4000A Jump Starter US$68.14 (~A$95.78), GT3000 3000A US$43.48 (~A$61.12) Shipped @ GOOLOO Global Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: GOOLOO GT4000 4000A Jump Starter US$68.14 (~A$95.78), GT3000 3000A US$43.48 (~A$61.12) Shipped @ GOOLOO Global Store AliExpress

[richy_o] How long do these things last on standby?
[1jwoz] Could probably go a year, but it's best to give them a charge every few months to prevent them from not working prematurely.
[dufflover] I would say the opposite, like any lithium battery thing I used my Gooloo to charge a few random devices to guesstimate having it at 70-90% as a "storage charge". Just need to check the indicator every so often.
[nocure] Mines at 69% after 12 months (three uses) GT4000
[deadpoet] After 6 months, my GT4000S was down to 89% charge. So it could easily go for a year between charging.
[R3XNebular] Thanks mate, love your deals got the GT4000. Now give me a DDPAI Z60 PRO or equiv deal and I will give you my first born
[Clear] Haha can't say no to another one. Unsure when we'll see another DDPAI deal, as their Amazon team got really upset that we bet them by $9.99 lol
[R3XNebular] lol wow, are you saying there Z60 PRO has been $120ish on Amazon?
[Clear] Oh I was thinking of the Z50. Their Amazon team were trying to tell AliExpress that Amazon AU is billed in USD. I worked out that the difference was only $9.99.
[R3XNebular] @Clear: ah yes, if only the Z50 had a Starvis, would've pulled the trigger!
[viper8548] 100W PD but no 15V or 20V, does this mean no laptop charging?
[Clear] It has both. From the manual:
PD100W Max (5V/3A, 9V/3A, 12V/3A, 15V/3A, 20V/5A).
[viper8548] The coupon gives me $6 off Total AU$89.39, what am i doing wrong (GT3000)
[R3XNebular] $19.06 tracked for TopCashBack AU, effectively bringing the price to $76.72
[viper8548] How are you getting that price it’s not working for me?
[R3XNebular] Through top cashback not the AliExpress site.
[viper8548] it shows as 96Usd for me coupon -$9 = $87usd before topcashback
[ps3_andy] waaaait, so these can be used as a power bank!? can they go on an airplane? seems the gt4000 is just shy of 100wh so it's possible?
[ps3_andy] I wonder if it is any good as a power bank? I imagine the underlying battery tech is different than regular power banks to allow the high current discharge for jump starting.
[seb] What's the temperature rating on these? It seems to me that long term storage at high charge and potential hot life in a car trunk would be better served by LFP batteries?
[hongerwonger] is the 4000 that much more worth it than the 3000?
[takemymoney] I would highly recommend having one that can charge fast phones via USB. Got mine with slow USB for cheap but regret not paying a bit more. We Use every week since missus always forget to charge her phone and mine is using the cigarette lighter power.
[DiscountForThee] and mine is using the cigarette lighter power
Might just be more simple to get a car charger that has 2 high-power outputs?
